record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ICY_WIND: Froslass (3 stars, maxPP 80), Glalie (2 stars, maxPP 90), Snorunt (1 star, maxPP 100). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 25/50/100/200 by stars) to every enemy-team unit on a straight line from the caster through the cast target, and then lowers each hit unit's speed by a requested 10/20/40/80 (by stars). The speed change is not AP-scaled and is not a probability roll. The line continues past the target to the board edge.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the cells of the supercover line from the caster's cell toward the cast target and on to a point 12 cells away along the same angle (clipped to the board); the caster's own cell is on the line but filtered out as same-team
targeting.note: The target only fixes the line's angle: it is hit only if its cell lies on the computed line (a rounding/angle effect of the 12-cell end point could in principle miss it; effectInLine has no fall-back that touches the original target). Enemies behind the target are hit too. Allies are skipped.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster through the cast target to the board edge; every touched cell counts, diagonal crossings included

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line (each cell visited once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff along the line. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the hit unit) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect (consumed by the first hit); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. See knowledge/07367c34/core-mechanics.md section A.

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line, after its damage call (also when the damage was blocked or the unit died)
effects.scaling: addSpeed(-speedDebuff, caster, apBoost 0, crit false): the AP factor is (1 + 0 x AP/100) = 1 and crit is false, so neither AP nor crit scales the requested amount.
effects.resolution: applied change = requested after the item hooks, then clamped: speed = clamp(speed + value, 0, 300). Big Eater Belt (x1.25) does not apply because the change comes from the other team and is negative; Twist Band on the hit unit flips the change into a gain of the same size (+10/+20/+40); a Melmetal-passive unit would route half of the change to attack instead of speed. A unit already at 0 speed loses nothing; the change is not permanent (not written to the board pokemon).

starBehavior.note: Damage and speed change are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (200 and 80, also the ?? fallbacks) are not reachable by the bare factory star counts. maxPP differs per unit (100/90/80). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (angle rounding of the line end point).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the line; speed reductions from repeated casts stack until speed reaches the lower clamp 0, and last until the end of the fight (no timer is set here).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 25/50/100 (1/2/3 stars) per enemy on the line and a speed change of -10/-20/-40. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 for protected units. Applied speed change = requested, then Twist Band (sign flip) on the hit unit, then the 0..300 clamp; the caster's AP and crit do not scale it. Big Eater Belt does not change it (enemy debuff).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
What a lowered speed does to attack timing (the speed stat change was read, not its use in the attack cooldown)
unresolved: Whether the cast target is always on the computed line (effectInLine has no fallback to touch it; angle rounding was not exercised)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value

The speed table (10/20/40/80) is not covered by a machine-checked sourceTables entry because the shared check only compares one table per path; its values are recorded in effects.1.declaredRaw and cited by ab-speed-table
